court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Metropolitan Magistrate, 57th Court at Kurla, Mumbai
case_name: Abhinav Chandra And Anr vs State Of Maharashtra And Anr

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Abhinav Chandra, Pratibha Saxena, Prabhash Chander Saxena (husband and in-laws)
parties.respondent_defendant: The State of Maharashtra, Nimisha Chandra alias Nimisha Ram Dayal (wife)

facts_of_case: Petitioners seek quashing of FIR bearing C.R. No. 275 of 2017 registered with Govandi Police Station, Mumbai, for alleged offences punishable under Sections 498A, 406 r/w 34 of the Indian Penal Code. Parties have amicably settled their dispute.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can settle their disputes amicably and seek quashing of criminal proceedings.
legal_principles.held: Quashing is sought on the premise, that the parties have amicably settled their dispute.

legal_principles.principle: Parties can agree on terms of divorce, including custody and maintenance.
legal_principles.held: The said consent terms are at Exhibit - 'B', on page 177 of the petition. As per the said consent terms, the custody and guardianship of the minor daughter is to remain with the respondent No.2.

outcome.final_order: Quashing of FIR sought is allowed on the premise that parties have amicably settled their dispute.

keywords: Nimisha Chandra alias Nimisha Ram Dayal
